|   |   +-- resolve parentReference(config) and its parentArtifact
|   |   +-- storedCorrection = derivation.promptCorrection ?? instruction
|   |   +-- for derivation, find source-kind/id token among references and omittedReferences

|   |   +-- append nonblank trimmed correction
|   |   +-- collect references + omittedReferences, deduplicated by kind:targetId:lowercase-token
|   |   \-- advance artifact = parentArtifact
|   +-- reverse corrections; generate sourceToken; render numbered history blocks joined with blank lines

\-- diagramReferencesInPrompt(input): DiagramReferenceMention[]
